consequence.statement: New feature: Telemetry resources can now customize the waypoint proxy; no operational consequence is stated.

original.statement: Support for Telemetry customization in the waypoint proxy was added.

decision.reason: The release note [ev-437e36865221] only says support for `Telemetry` customization in the waypoint proxy was added. It does not say that anything fails, is rejected, stops being honoured or needs migrating. It also does not say that the default behaviour changes for operators who do nothing. On this evidence, an opt-in capability with consequence "none" (informational) fits, so no mandatory work or review is supported.
